item.title: How to Lower Your Water Bill Without Sacrificing Comfort
item.description:
Disclosure: Some links in this article are affiliate links. If you buy through them, we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. This never affects our recommendations — see our affiliate disclosure.

Quick Answer

Lower your water bill by 10-30% through simple habit changes like fixing leaks, installing low-flow fixtures, and reducing shower time. The average household wastes 10,000 gallons of water annually from leaks alone—costing hundreds of dollars.
